summary: One-time static singleton initializer. Guards on the bit-0 init gate byte_5EA4E0: on first call it sets the gate bit, constructs a generic vtable-backed object into the static buffer unk_5EA440, and runs the load-path wrapper registration through BooleanToIntConversion. Every call returns the static buffer handle &unk_5EA440.

operations.description: Check init gate byte_5EA4E0 bit 0; when clear, the one-time initialization block runs.
Set the initialized bit of the gate: byte_5EA4E0 |= 1.
Construct a generic vtable-backed object into the static buffer unk_5EA440 via GenericObjectConstructorWithVTable.
Register the load-path wrapper InitLoadPathWrapper through BooleanToIntConversion.

unresolved: Semantics of the BooleanToIntConversion(InitLoadPathWrapper) atexit-style registration are not grounded by the raw source.
